blocks.text:
Day 7 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour city tour with an English-speaking guide: the old district of La Boca; San Telmo, with its bars, restaurants and the antiques market of Plaza Dorrego; the Plaza de Mayo and the Casa Rosada, the presidential palace linked to the memory of Eva Perón; the 67-metre Obelisk on Avenida 9 de Julio, one of the widest avenues in the world; elegant Recoleta, with its famous cemetery and the colonial church of El Pilar; and modern Puerto Madero.

Evening · A tango show with dinner. Born in the port districts of Buenos Aires among immigrants and gauchos, tango is today one of the most sensual dances in the world; a menu of traditional dishes and excellent Argentine wines completes this romantic evening.
